title: V-belt pulley blank

description.en: A pulley blank turned about the Z axis, from Z = 0 to Z = 20: outer diameter 60 mm, a 12 mm bore through it, and one V-groove round its rim in the middle of its width: 8 mm deep, its flanks 40 degrees apart (each 20 degrees off the radial direction), with a flat bottom 2 mm wide. Make it as a revolution of its half section. Drive it by the variables outer_d, width, bore_d, groove_depth, groove_angle and groove_flat.
description.nl: Een poelieblank, gedraaid om de Z-as, van Z = 0 tot Z = 20: buitendiameter 60 mm, een boring van 12 mm erdoor, en één V-groef rond de rand in het midden van de breedte: 8 mm diep, de flanken 40 graden uit elkaar (elk 20 graden naast de straalrichting), met een vlakke bodem van 2 mm breed. Maak hem als omwenteling van zijn halve doorsnede. Stuur hem met de variabelen outer_d, width, bore_d, groove_depth, groove_angle en groove_flat.

variables.name: groove_flat
variables.meaning: width of the groove's flat bottom

expect.value: pi * ((outer_d / 2)^2 - (bore_d / 2)^2) * width - 2 * pi * ((outer_d / 2) - groove_depth + groove_depth * (groove_flat + 2 * (groove_flat + 2 * groove_depth * tan(groove_angle / 2))) / (3 * (groove_flat + (groove_flat + 2 * groove_depth * tan(groove_angle / 2))))) * (groove_depth * ((groove_flat + 2 * groove_depth * tan(groove_angle / 2)) + groove_flat) / 2)

2 * pi * ((outer_d / 2)^2 - (bore_d / 2)^2) + 2 * pi * (bore_d / 2) * width + 2 * pi * (outer_d / 2) * (width - (groove_flat + 2 * groove_depth * tan(groove_angle / 2))) + 2 * pi * ((outer_d / 2) - groove_depth) * groove_flat + 2 * pi * (2 * (outer_d / 2) - groove_depth) * groove_depth / cos(groove_angle / 2)

derivation: The plain disc: pi (R^2 - rb^2) W. The groove's section is a trapezoid of height h (radially), with parallel sides f at the bottom (radius R - h) and wt = f + 2 h tan(a/2) at the rim.

Pappus: the groove removes 2 pi rg Ag, with Ag = h (wt + f) / 2 and rg = R - h + h (f + 2 wt) / (3 (f + wt)), the trapezoid's centroid radius (the centroid of a trapezoid lies h (f + 2 wt) / (3 (f + wt)) from its side f).

Area: two flat rings 2 pi (R^2 - rb^2), the bore 2 pi rb W, the rim outside the groove 2 pi R (W - wt), the groove's bottom 2 pi (R - h) f, and two cone flanks, each pi (R + (R - h)) times the slant h / cos(a/2).
The groove is in the middle, so the centroid is at Z = W/2 on the axis.
